To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DNA of 6-month-old rats is synthesized in a more rapid and more uniform manner than that of 24-month-old rats.

the rate of DNA replication in liver of old animals is slower than in young animals and that the transition of the single-stranded DNA intermediate to double stranded DNA proceeds more slowly in old liver.
the transition from single-stranded to double-stranded DNA occurs more slowly in the livers of old animals than it does in adult ones.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the age-dependent differences in the rate of DNA replication in the rat liver.
the study of the age and features of DNA synthesis in intact white rat livers.
the age and features of DNA synthesis in the liver of adult and old rats.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DNA of the liver cells of the old animals has a higher degree of structural and functional immaturity than that of the adult cells.
the age-related changes in the liver DNA synthesis are not due to an increase of the rate of the DNA synthesis per se, but rather to a change in the mechanism and regulation of the DNA synthesis.

in the liver of young rats the replication of DNA occurs at a high speed, while in old animals it proceeds more slowly, and the transition of newly formed DNA from the single-stranded to double-stranded state is also retarded.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DNA of adult and old animals replicates by the same mechanism but with different efficiency.
DNA replication in adult rat liver occurs in a more rapid manner than in old rat liver.
the DNA of adult and old rat liver has a common pattern of replication and that the main difference in the DNA of old and adult liver is in the speed of replication.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DNA of the liver of adult and old animals replicates with the same efficiency.
the liver of old rats is less capable of DNA replication than adult animals.
the DNA replication in the liver of adult and old rats proceeds in a similar way.
